subject: radiology
title: Picture Frame Vertebra, Ivory Vertebra and Rugger Jersey Spine

steps.title: Picture frame means Paget bone
steps.tx: **Picture frame vertebra** thickens the cortical rim of a vertebral body while the centre stays relatively lucent, framing the vertebra like a picture in Paget disease of bone. The pictured metabolic bone set places that frame beside osteoporosis and osteomalacia patterns. The vertebra also enlarges compared with neighbours, a size gain metastases and myeloma never produce, making enlargement the quiet discriminator in a crowded spine film.

steps.title: Paget phases on film
steps.tx: **Paget disease** marches through lytic, mixed and sclerotic phases: a flame shaped lytic front advances down a long bone, cotton wool sclerosis fills the skull, then dense coarse trabeculae thicken everything. Alkaline phosphatase climbs with activity while calcium stays normal in most, the blood split from myeloma and metastases. Sarcomatous transformation declares itself with new pain, cortical destruction and a soft tissue mass inside old Paget bone.

Alkaline phosphatase climbs while calcium stays normal. New pain with cortical destruction inside old Paget bone declares sarcomatous transformation.

steps.title: Ivory vertebra differential
steps.tx: **Ivory vertebra** is one uniformly dense white vertebral body with normal size and shape, and its list runs lymphoma, osteoblastic metastasis, Paget disease and infection. Prostate and breast cancers seed the osteoblastic deposits in older adults, often at several levels with disc spaces preserved. A single ivory vertebra in a young adult with night sweats leans lymphoma, while Paget adds enlargement and the picture frame rim.

Prostate and breast cancers seed such deposits in older adults. A single ivory vertebra in a young adult with night sweats leans lymphoma instead.

steps.title: Rugger jersey stripes the spine
steps.tx: **Rugger jersey spine** bands the top and bottom of each vertebral body with dense sclerosis and leaves the centre lucent, striping the spine like a rugby shirt in renal osteodystrophy. The pictured renal bone set shows that banding from secondary hyperparathyroidism of chronic kidney disease. Subperiosteal hand resorption, brown tumours and vascular calcification travel with it, so one lateral spine film can announce years of disordered parathyroid hormone.

The pictured set shows that banding from secondary hyperparathyroidism. Hand resorption and brown tumours travel with it, announcing years of disordered parathyroid hormone.

steps.title: Osteoporosis loses height silently
steps.tx: **Osteoporotic vertebra** loses trabecular bone until the body wedges, biconcaves around a swollen disc as a codfish shape, or crushes flat, each deformity costing height and kyphosis. Plain films need roughly thirty percent bone loss before lucency convinces anyone, so DEXA, not the radiograph, makes the diagnosis. A vertebra collapsing below the third lumbar level or with a destroyed pedicle should be read as malignant until proven otherwise.

steps.title: Vertebra plana in a child
steps.tx: **Vertebra plana** flattens a child vertebral body to a thin disc with preserved neighbouring discs, classically from Langerhans cell histiocytosis whose lytic phase preceded the collapse. Infection and leukaemia enter the same differential, so the flattened vertebra in a child earns MRI and often biopsy rather than reassurance. Remarkably the body can rebuild substantial height over years of growth, a recovery adult crush fractures never achieve.

steps.title: Pott spine destroys the disc
steps.tx: **Pott spine** is tuberculous spondylitis eroding the front of vertebral bodies beside a disc it destroys late, spreading under the anterior longitudinal ligament to neighbours and leaking paravertebral and psoas abscesses. Gibbus kyphosis follows anterior collapse. Metastasis instead spares the disc and eats the pedicle, the winking owl sign on frontal films, so disc state plus pedicle state split infection from tumour at one glance.

steps.title: Bone scan lights Paget and spread
steps.tx: **Bone scintigraphy** maps Paget activity and metastatic burden in one whole body pass, Paget bone glowing intensely through its whole expanded shape while metastases dot the axial skeleton randomly. A superscan washes the skeleton uniformly bright with faint kidneys when prostate metastases saturate bone. Plain films then characterise the hot spots that matter, because scintigraphy shouts sensitivity and whispers specificity in every metabolic and metastatic read.
